personas.name: New employee
personas.role_description: A new employee who does not know the company's internal terms and asks in colloquial everyday words, often vaguely.

personas.name: Non-native speaker
personas.role_description: A customer or colleague writing in a second language with simple vocabulary, short sentences and occasional grammar mistakes.

personas.name: Domain expert
personas.role_description: A specialist who uses precise product names, codes and terms and wants an exact figure or condition.
